name: Continue with Recovery Code
description: Collects one TOTP recovery code for an already identified durable identity when the authenticator is unavailable.

web.implementation: Uses generated AuthClient.createMfarecoveryLogin with the short-lived password-issued MFA challenge, exposes canonical recovery-code error state, remains on rejection, and clears challenge state after successful completion or restart.

mobile.implementation: Uses AuthContext.signInWithRecoveryCodeAsync, which consumes generated AuthClient.createMfarecoveryToken with the in-memory password-issued MFA challenge and stores tokens only after accepted recovery proof. The canonical status:recovery-error state is exposed on rejection.

notes: This surface is entered only after a primary password credential has produced a short-lived MFA challenge.
A rejected recovery code remains on this view and must not disclose whether the code was invalid, already consumed, or otherwise unavailable.
Both stable clients consume generated Auth contracts from nuviot/nuvos-app-contracts commit 56f0679a24579937052d7bafb362fa2ef703910a.
